frameworks.name: 10-Stage Revenue Scaling Roadmap
frameworks.definition: A structured progression from zero to $100M+ revenue with eight business functions mapped across all stages, including constraint diagnosis, symptom identification, and proven graduation steps applicable across software, physical products, services, and brick-and-mortar.

claims.text: The public perception of Alex Hormozi is that he is meaner than he actually is; in private settings with his team, he jokes frequently and uses informal humor.
claims.speaker: Alex Hormozi
bounded_by: Does not imply he is not serious about business execution
Humor frequency increases in team settings vs. public appearances

claims.text: The 10-stage revenue roadmap from zero to $100M+ has been successfully executed by less than 1% of companies, but has been completed multiple times by Alex Hormozi himself across software, physical products, service businesses, and brick-and-mortar models, enabling high-confidence identification of each stage's constraints.
claims.speaker: Alex Hormozi
claims.mechanism: Repeatable success across diverse business models provides empirical validation of stage definitions
bounded_by: The roadmap applies to scaling, not to startup validation or sub-$1M revenue stage
Constraint sequences may vary by industry but core progression is consistent

practices.text: Access the 10-stage revenue scaling roadmap by visiting acquisition.com/roadmap and entering your information to receive a detailed breakdown of all eight business functions, constraint symptoms, and proven graduation steps.
